definitions.explanation: A three-month period, especially in business and financial contexts. One fourth of a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧1{四半期|しはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だった。
examples.english: Sales in the first quarter were strong.

examples.japanese: {四半期|しはんき}ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}{報告|ほうこく}→決算報告：25816_kessanhoukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We issue financial reports every quarter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{四半期|しはんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: We plan to focus on a new project in the next quarter.

notes:
BUSINESS USAGE:
In Japan, the fiscal year typically runs from April to March:
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧1{四半期|しはんき} (Q1): April-June
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧2{四半期|しはんき} (Q2): July-September
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧3{四半期|しはんき} (Q3): October-December
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧4{四半期|しはんき} (Q4): January-March

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {四半期|しはんき}{決算|けっさん} (quarterly financial results)
- {四半期|しはんき}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (quarterly report)
- {四半期|しはんき}ごと (quarterly, every quarter)
